# Synthetic-credential fixtures. security.test.ts builds a credential URL from
# the literal "user:private-key@provider.example"; a later commit replaced it
# with a constructed value, but the commit that added it stays in branch history.
# Exclude the fixture path so the historical commit does not fail the scan.
packages/harness-sdk/src/plugins/remote-model/security\.test\.ts

# Preview-link fixtures. preview-link.test.ts asserts that a preview URL with
# embedded credentials ("user:secret@localhost") is rejected. Exclude the
# fixture path so the synthetic credential URI does not fail the scan.
